claim.quote: These figures provide a 90% c.l. upper limit to the number of nuclear recoils of 10.4 events in this acceptance window, which converts to a WIMP-nucleon spin-independent cross-section with a minimum of 6.6x10^-7 pb following the inclusion of an energy dependent, calibrated, efficiency.

key_value.note: Minimum of the spin-independent WIMP-nucleon cross-section limit.
key_value.quote: a minimum of 6.6x10^-7 pb following the inclusion of an energy dependent, calibrated, efficiency

name: First limits on WIMP nuclear recoil signals in ZEPLIN-II: a two phase xenon detector for dark matter detection

summary.plain: ZEPLIN-II's first underground run saw as many events as expected from radioactive background, so it set a limit on dark matter.
summary.technical: 31 live days, 225 kg d exposure after cuts; 29 events observed in the 5-20 keVee nuclear recoil acceptance window against a summed expectation of 28.6 +/- 4.3 background events; a radon-progeny background population was identified.

title: First limits on WIMP nuclear recoil signals in ZEPLIN-II: a two phase xenon detector for dark matter detection
why_it_matters: First limit from a two-phase xenon detector run underground at Boulby.
